title: sql
summary: Runs one read-only SQL statement against an index database and prints the result set

surfaces.usage: drag-lint sql --query "SELECT ..." | --file <q.sql> --db <file.sqlite> [--format text|json] [--json] [--limit N] [--timeout-ms N] [--output <file>] (guarded READ-ONLY SQL over the index: exactly one statement, an sqlite3 authorizer refuses ATTACH/PRAGMA/DDL/writes, row cap 200 and time cap 10000 ms; ask `schema --format json` for the columns)
